description: Newest White Report articles (headline, summary, dates, URLs). Start here for the newest coverage; use search_articles instead when you have a topic or keyword, and get_article for one article's full text once you have its slug. Returns briefs only — headline, url, slug, datePublished, category, summary, tickers, entities, and up to 5 keyFacts per article — newest first; undated legacy articles are excluded (search_articles reaches them). limit is clamped to 1-20. Returns {articles, note}. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication or API key; answers are served from the site's published article files, not a live database, and every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).
name: get_latest
title: Get Latest Articles
